description: FAST feature detector: serial doubled-ring scan (16 pixels) against center+/-threshold.
limitations: Serial ring scan chosen for area over parallel comparators.

clock_reset.clk_en: step enable on sequential logic; tie 1 for full rate

selftest_protocol: unit selftest contract: pulse start (1 clk_en beat) after rst_n; cell runs its internal stimulus against the embedded DUT and raises done; pass==1 iff the FNV-1a digest equals the golden value and all output bytes matched the golden dump.  Verdicts use === so X cannot fake PASS.  Tie clk_en=1 for full rate.

validation.sim: iverilog unit sim PASS (byte-exact golden dump) + w2_selftest aggregate PASS (masks FFFFFFFFFF / 00000FFFFF / FFFFF00000)
validation.board: PASS on Tang Primer 20K (GW2A-LV18PG256C8/I7) via grouped -noalu bitstreams, UART report verified -- see doc/VALIDATION_LOG.md. NOTE: board images MUST be built with synth_gowin -noalu; GW2A ALU cells produce wrong results for some input patterns on silicon.
